title: Satisfaction of a homogeneous quadratic equation
statement: For $n\ge 0$, a homogeneous quadratic equation with coefficient matrix $A\in\mathbb F_2^{n\times n}$ and right-hand side $b\in\mathbb F_2$ is satisfied by $w\in\mathbb F_2^n$ when the matrix pairing of $A$ with $ww^{\mathsf T}$ equals $b$ in $\mathbb F_2$.
hypotheses_covered: Homogeneous quadratic equation with coefficient matrix $A$ and right-hand side $b$
caveat: The matrix pairing is referenced but not defined in the supplied material, so its exact coordinate formula is unavailable.
